title: el Gaada
description: A Roman-era fort located west of ancient Volubilis in the modern Moroccan municipality of el Gaada.

properties.description: Point digitized in QGIS from raster image of BAtlas Map 28, which was georegistered to the original base projection (ONC G-1) by the Ancient World Mapping Center in September 2002. Dates after BAtlDir.
